headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by strong AI‑driven sales.
summary: Top‑line growth was broadly positive, with TCS reporting 15% YoY revenue rise and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech highlighted AI sales as a key driver, posting 3% QoQ revenue growth and a 78% YoY jump in AI revenue. Mid‑tier players such as LTM and Tech Mahindra also delivered double‑digit revenue growth. Several peers have not yet released results, limiting a full sector view.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Companies that disclosed AI revenue (TCS, HCLTech, LTM) showed higher margins and double‑digit profit growth.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: Wipro's operating margin slipped to 16.5% and its net profit fell modestly, indicating cost pressures despite revenue growth.
